resignation, incapacity or removal from office of an office
bearer,  having  regard  to  the  rules  of  the  Corporation,  the
committee  shall  power  to  elect  or  appoint  a  person  to  fill

annual general meeting;
(c) to purchase, lease out or rent, sale or sell or otherwise
obtain any movable or immovable property which may be
required for the purpose of the Corporation and which may
lawfully  be  acquired  for  the  purpose  and  to  deal  with  or
dispose  of  the  same,  as  it  deem  expedient  with  a  view  to
promoting the object of the Corporation;
(d) to appoint, employ and dismiss the employees required
for carrying out of the objects of the Corporation;
(e) maintain relationship with local and foreign institutions
which function with similar objectives and co-ordinate with
them; and
(f) Committee shall have the power do all other acts and
things  as  are  necessary  or  expedient  for  the  proper  and
effective carrying out of the objects of the Corporation.
